Annual fee examples at private universities in Italy

Domus Academy MA: €22,500 (2027/28, non-EU; EU €17,500)
Bocconi MSc: €19,300 (2027/28, first year)
LUISS master's: €16,000 (2027/28; Management and Finance €18,000)
Cattolica master's: €9,350 (2026/27, non-EU; €6,400 with scholarship)

Years are mixed (2026/27 and 2027/28). At Bocconi and Cattolica, exemptions and scholarships can lower the fee. Bachelor's fees differ.

Source: domusacademy.com, unibocconi.it, luiss.it, international.unicatt.it (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.

“Turkish students also need an APS certificate for Germany”

The truth: The uni-assist list names three countries. In the uni-assist glossary, APS (a diploma verification certificate) is required only for China, India and Vietnam. Türkiye is not mentioned. Ask the university too.

Source: uni-assist.de, tu-dresden.de (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.

info.text:
In Italy, your income sets your public university fee

1. What is ISEE: Family income and assets indicator. At Bologna, €27,000 or less pays only a €157.04 installment in the first year (2026/27).
2. Income abroad: If your income is in Türkiye, you need separate documents instead of ISEE. Some institutions charge a fixed fee by country.
3. Examples: At Sapienza, the Türkiye group pays €700 (bands €300, €700, €1,500). At Verona, a fixed €1,000 for non-EU students without ISEE.
4. Timing: Bologna 2026/27: first installment €157.04 for bachelor's on 24 September 2026; second 18 December, third 15 March 2027.

The cap depends on the program. Ask the university about extra costs.

Source: unibo.it, uniroma1.it, univr.it (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.
